title: Module 2: Development & Implementation Phases
description: Show how design plans become instructional assets and how those assets are launched, facilitated, and supported during implementation.

learning_objectives.statement: Describe the transition from storyboards (Design) to tangible assets (Development)
Outline the key logistical and pedagogical steps in the Implementation phase
Evaluate how development choices affect fidelity, usability, and rollout quality

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
